summary: Completed regression testing of the Almousawi homepage across public API, desktop UI, and 390px mobile UI. Requested anchors, uploaded logos, hero contrast, wave treatment, modal/contact flow, capabilities, ecosystem, project imagery, mobile menu, and overflow checks passed.

integration_issues.issue: ContactModal sets success after fetch without checking response.ok; a backend 4xx/5xx response could display a false success state.

action_items: Check response.ok in ContactModal before showing success and show an error state for API validation/server failures.
critical_code_review_comments: The contact submit handler awaits fetch but ignores HTTP status; rejected API requests can be presented as successfully sent.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed contact inquiries and status records through regression tests; no seeded production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and 390px mobile regression flows passed. Recheck contact API failure handling after response.ok/error-state changes; malformed email currently returns 422 as expected.
rca of the issue: The backend correctly rejects malformed email input with Pydantic EmailStr and returns 422. The frontend catch block only handles network exceptions, while fetch resolves normally for HTTP errors; because setSent(true) follows any resolved fetch, API failures can be misreported as success.
